instruction: How much money have I sent or received to my roommates on venmo since 1st Mar of this year?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed, so the goal only demands the knowledge predicate (found-total amount-total) plus (task-completed). The supervisor profile supplies the phone username (phone_number) and venmo username (email); passwords come from show_account_passwords. phone.search_contacts with query/relationship 'roommates' discovers the roommates' emails; the number of roommates is unknown, so a single representative person object 'roommate' stands for every contact returned and the venmo.show_transactions step is executed once per contact email at runtime and amounts are summed. phone.get_current_date_and_time establishes the current year used to build min_created_at = 2023-03-01; show_transactions is called without a direction filter so both sent and received transactions are counted. supervisor.complete_task takes the summed amount as its answer and is structurally forced to be the last action.
